integrity: All probabilities and displayed correlations are derived from exact finite enumeration and algebra. The continuous parameter interval is proved by exact factorization and sign analysis, not by a grid search. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The claim gives an explicit robust counterexample to the proposed same-transform correlation equality at \(N=4,n=3\). It does not determine the global exact values of \(R_4^{{\prime\prime}}\) or \(R_4^{{\prime}}\), classify all maximizing transforms, or extend the classification to other support sizes.
title: A four-point counterexample to the monotone same-transform order-statistic correlation conjecture
